### Cosmetics stores in Las Vegas
https://placetta.com/guides/las-vegas/cosmetics-store.html
1. Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN), Internal Revenue Service. Owners with an SSN or ITIN apply online. A company whose responsible party has neither (most China-based owners) faxes or mails Form SS-4, or calls the IRS international line. Fee: Free. https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fss4.pdf
2. LLC formation and state business license, Nevada Secretary of State (SilverFlume). Form the company and get the state business license together online. Fee: Varies. https://www.nvsilverflume.gov
3. Create/Update Importer Identity Form, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Sent to CBP (usually through your customs broker), or created in the ACE portal. Needed before your first entry as importer of record. Fee: Free. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-06/cbp_form_5106.pdf
4. Customs Bond, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Bought from a CBP-approved surety, usually through your customs broker, who files it electronically. A continuous bond covers a year of entries. Fee: Varies. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2024-05/cbp_form_301.pdf
5. Cosmetic product facility registration (MoCRA), U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Filed online in Cosmetics Direct by the facility that makes or processes the cosmetics. Fee: Free. https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/registration-listing-cosmetic-product-facilities-and-products
6. Cosmetic product listing (MoCRA), U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Filed online in Cosmetics Direct by the brand (the responsible person on the label), one listing per product. Fee: Free. https://www.fda.gov/cosmetics/registration-listing-cosmetic-product-facilities-and-products
7. Product safety certificate, filed electronically at entry, U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. The importer issues the certificate itself (there is no government form) and, under the eFiling rule, files the certificate data with CBP at entry. Fee: Free. https://www.cpsc.gov/eFiling
8. Las Vegas business license, City of Las Vegas, Business Licensing. Get the city or Clark County business license, depending on where the store is. Fee: Varies. https://www.lasvegasnevada.gov

### Importers and online sellers in Las Vegas
https://placetta.com/guides/las-vegas/importer-ecommerce.html
1. Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN), Internal Revenue Service. Owners with an SSN or ITIN apply online. A company whose responsible party has neither (most China-based owners) faxes or mails Form SS-4, or calls the IRS international line. Fee: Free. https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fss4.pdf
2. LLC formation and state business license, Nevada Secretary of State (SilverFlume). Form the company and get the state business license together online. Fee: Varies. https://www.nvsilverflume.gov
3. Create/Update Importer Identity Form, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Sent to CBP (usually through your customs broker), or created in the ACE portal. Needed before your first entry as importer of record. Fee: Free. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-06/cbp_form_5106.pdf
4. Customs Bond, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Bought from a CBP-approved surety, usually through your customs broker, who files it electronically. A continuous bond covers a year of entries. Fee: Varies. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2024-05/cbp_form_301.pdf
5. ACE Secure Data Portal account for importers, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Applied for online in ACE. Lets you see your entries, duties and bond. Fee: Free. https://www.cbp.gov/trade/automated/getting-started/portal-applying
6. Product safety certificate, filed electronically at entry, U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. The importer issues the certificate itself (there is no government form) and, under the eFiling rule, files the certificate data with CBP at entry. Fee: Free. https://www.cpsc.gov/eFiling
7. Las Vegas business license, City of Las Vegas, Business Licensing. Get the city or Clark County business license, depending on where the store is. Fee: Varies. https://www.lasvegasnevada.gov

### Warehouses and 3PLs in Las Vegas
https://placetta.com/guides/las-vegas/warehouse-3pl.html
1. Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN), Internal Revenue Service. Owners with an SSN or ITIN apply online. A company whose responsible party has neither (most China-based owners) faxes or mails Form SS-4, or calls the IRS international line. Fee: Free. https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fss4.pdf
2. LLC formation and state business license, Nevada Secretary of State (SilverFlume). Form the company and get the state business license together online. Fee: Varies. https://www.nvsilverflume.gov
3. Create/Update Importer Identity Form, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Sent to CBP (usually through your customs broker), or created in the ACE portal. Needed before your first entry as importer of record. Fee: Free. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-06/cbp_form_5106.pdf
4. Customs Bond, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Bought from a CBP-approved surety, usually through your customs broker, who files it electronically. A continuous bond covers a year of entries. Fee: Varies. https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2024-05/cbp_form_301.pdf
5. ACE Secure Data Portal account for importers, U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Applied for online in ACE. Lets you see your entries, duties and bond. Fee: Free. https://www.cbp.gov/trade/automated/getting-started/portal-applying
6. Hazardous materials registration, Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (DOT). Filed online when you ship or offer certain hazardous materials in bulk, such as large lithium battery shipments. Fee: Varies. https://hazmatonline.phmsa.dot.gov/services/
7. Las Vegas business license, City of Las Vegas, Business Licensing. Get the city or Clark County business license, depending on where the store is. Fee: Varies. https://www.lasvegasnevada.gov
